sample: A sample judgment for the worked example, filled in by hand to show what a verdict looks like and what judge record does with it. It is one reading of the packet, not a model run, and another judge may answer differently. hyperspec ignores this field.

good.evidence: Pick one thing you can act on this week, say what you will do, and do it before you meet again.
good.note: The follow-through is what experienced managers say makes the meeting worth having, and it is concrete.

improve.evidence: After the third question, stop talking.
improve.note: Right for most reports, but a new or quiet report may say nothing at all; say what to do when the silence runs on.

remove.evidence: My first one-on-one as a manager was a disaster
remove.note: An experienced reader has heard this story many times, and the survey already makes the case it makes.
